payload.core_composition_summary: Greedy min-heap selection combined with binary search on sorted list to dynamically maintain candidate pool.
payload.rationale: Greedy strategy repeatedly selects the cheapest team to float using a priority queue, and after each give-away, binary search adds teams now with balloons <= current count to the heap.
